title: Bach Ma, one trail
summary: Report before 09:00, walk the road the gate is actually using, and add one trail. Be back at the visitor center before 17:00. A summit night is a separate registration, made at least one day ahead.

days.title: The road, then one trail
days.body: Be at the visitor center before 09:00 so the park can group the walk. The 2021 feature puts the gate-to-summit road at about 16 km and about 4–5 hours on foot. From 1 Jan 2026 the notice stops motor vehicles at km 12. The notice says about 500 m across the slip, then about 7 km on foot. In June 2026 the director said about 600 m on a path around the slip, then a motorbike or more walking. Add thác Đỗ Quyên or Ngũ Hồ, not both, and not the viewpoint as well, if you still have to be down before 17:00. A night on the summit is only the registration the park has already accepted.

stops.name: The road from the gate
stops.note: The 240 minutes is the short end of the 4–5 hour gate-to-summit walk on the 2021 feature, not a clock for the km 12 slip. The 2026 notice says about 500 m across the slip, then about 7 km on foot. The June 2026 account says about 600 m on a path, then a motorbike or more walking. Confirm which rule the gate is using.

approach.note: Start at the visitor center before 09:00. A car of 16 seats or fewer is the May 2025 shuttle table. That table and the km 12 notice disagree. Check on arrival.

stops.name: Do Quyen Waterfall
stops.note: The park trail page says about 30 minutes for about 1.5 km from km 16. VnExpress agrees on about 30 minutes for that leg. The height is higher than 300 m on the trail page, about 300 m on the walking page, and nearly 400 m on VnExpress. Ngũ Hồ is the other trail: 30 minutes on the park page, nearly an hour on VnExpress. Do not add both.

approach.note: From the summit, the road down to km 16, then the path. The 2021 feature says about 3 km by road from the viewpoint, then about 2 km of path. The trail page says about 1.5 km from km 16.

seoTitle: Bach Ma in a day: the road, then one trail
seoDescription: A Bach Ma day starts before 09:00 and ends at the visitor center before 17:00. The km 12 rules disagree. Add Do Quyen or the five lakes, not both.
